Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Houston, Texas city council ordinance bars AIDS victims from public service employment 2. California campuses elect gay activist, Dan greening as UC system's student president 3. On Republican mayor candidate, Diane McGrath 4. Gay worker loses suit to obtain bereavement leave 5. Canadian customs officials seize gay literature COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. Public Health Service unveils long range plan for controlling AIDS 7. Colorado becomes first state to require HTLVIII test results 8. New findings link AIDS with swine flu 9. New Jersey State Legislature reviews two AIDS related bills COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 10. Sports, includes clip 11. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Ken Wein, clinical psychologist, discusses psychological aspects of AIDS 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity with Stephen Lax 2. Sybil Bruncheon returns COMMERCIAL: GMHC Healthy Sex Workshops 3. Broadway Confidential, includes "Twilight zone" clip COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 4. Women Identified, includes street responses and interview with Andrea Dworkin
